propositions: Four code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must transition from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 corpus analysis (1760 sidecars, 1173 changes, 4359 findings).
Regression and error-handling are new base-reviewer dimension entries in criteria_routing.json with only default_posture, block_threshold, and blocking_enabled consulted by threshold_for resolution.

Three governance-pin tests must be updated to assert the new 7-member approved blocking set (including secret-detection, high-critical-security, security, api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling).
The calibrated thresholds show validity ≥0.83 and precision-first criteria where every would-block finding meets the blocking validity bar, ensuring low false-positive volume.
Landing must occur before RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) derives its immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden from the flipped criteria_routing.json.
